scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @sztu-gpa/backend" "npm run dev --workspace @sztu-gpa/frontend"
scripts.dev:network: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @sztu-gpa/backend" "npm run dev:network --workspace @sztu-gpa/frontend"
scripts.dev:pages: npm run build && wrangler pages dev frontend/dist
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy frontend/dist --project-name sztu-gpa-planner
scripts.package:baota: npm run build && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File deploy/baota/package.ps1
